content.title: 非限制性定语从句·who / which / whose / where / when 速查
content.intro: 非限制性定语从句用逗号和主句隔开,只对先行词补充说明,去掉后主句仍成立。判断口诀:指人 who/whom、指物 which、表所属 whose、地点 where、时间 when;非限制性里 that 永远不能用。

rows: 指人作主语:Tu Youyou, who discovered artemisinin, won the prize.
指人作宾语:Zhong Nanshan, whom we all admire, is brave.
指物作主/宾,或指代整个主句:The book, which came out in 2015, …;She failed 190 times, which surprised us all.
表所属(人或物):Einstein, whose hair stood on end, looked odd.
地点 / 时间:Hainan, where malaria was common, …;1933, when Hitler came to power, …
some of which / most of whom / in which case

specialRules.rule: 非限制性定语从句里绝对不能用 that(最常见干扰项)
which 可指代前面整个主句,意为‘这件事’
specialRules.mark: She failed many times, which surprised us.

specialRules.rule: ‘量词/介词 + which/whom’:指物用 which、指人用 whom
specialRules.mark: some of which / most of whom

specialRules.rule: whose = ‘…的’,后接名词,指人指物都行
specialRules.mark: the scientist whose research led to…

why: 非限制性从句给的是‘补充信息’,语气上像插一句话,所以前后用逗号;正因为它独立、可去掉,英语习惯不用 that,而用 who/which/whose/where/when。
gaokaoPoints: 语法填空高频:看先行词指人/指物 + 从句缺什么成分,选 who/whom/which/whose/where/when。
易错点:非限制性里误用 that;指人误用 which;which 指代整句时别误判为指某个名词。
‘介词/量词 + which/whom’结构(some of which / all of whom)是中高考常考点。

examVsReal.exam: Tu Youyou, who discovered artemisinin, won the prize.（考试/书面)
examVsReal.real: Tu Youyou discovered artemisinin, and she won the prize.
examVsReal.note: 考试爱用非限制性从句;口语里常拆成两个简单句、用 and 连接

examVsReal.exam: She failed many times, which surprised us all.（考试)
examVsReal.real: She failed many times — and that surprised us all.
examVsReal.note: 考试用 which 指代整句;口语常用 and that 或破折号
